distinct_grid_states:
TWO distinct grids across the artifacts this channel actually opened, plus two artifacts that deliberately carry no grid.

GRID A — the 2017 SGX portal grid, "Trading Hours* for SGX Derivatives Market", 88 contract rows. Seen at capture 20170705000242 (sgxweb_ch) and capture 20170927124017 (sgxweb English). A programmatic set-diff of the two 88-row tables returned zero rows unique to either side, so this is ONE state, and the captures bracket it: 2017-07-05 00:02:42 through 2017-09-27 12:40:17. Nikkei 225 Futures 7.30 am to 2.25 pm / 2.55 pm to 4.45 am; FTSE China A50 9:00 am to 4:30 pm / 5.00 pm to 4.45 am; MSCI Singapore Futures 8.30am to 5.10 pm / 5.40 pm to 4.45 am; MSCI Taiwan Futures 8.45 am to 1.45 pm / 2.15 pm to 4.45 am; NTR (USD) suite ABSENT from the artifact entirely. This is the load-bearing find: the T+1 close is already 4.45 am on 2017-07-05, which means the 2.00 am T+1 close on the WCM fragment captured 2018-07-11 was ALREADY SUPERSEDED nearly a year before that capture. Two SGX-published states coexisted on sgx.com through 2018 — the live portal page at 4.45 am and an orphaned WCM fragment at 2.00 am — and the fragment is the stale one.

NO GRID — captures 20181020041054 and 20181223111840 of the same English portal URL. Between 2017-09-27 and 2018-10-20 SGX deleted the table from the page and replaced it with "For information relating to trading hours, please refer to the SGX calendar 2018 or contract specifications of the applicable product." So for the whole of the 2018-2019 stretch SGX's own answer was the calendar PDF — and that PDF is exactly what is now unreachable (see dead ends). The 2018 and 2019 grid states are therefore NOT recoverable through this channel.

GRID B — the 2020 boundary edition, "Trading Hours of SGX Futures and Options Contracts" in SGX Derivatives Trading Calendar 2020, document-dated 2 January 2020, fetched live 2026-09-06. Nikkei 7.30am to 2.25pm / 2.55pm to 5.15am; A50 9.00am to 4.30pm / 5.00pm to 5.15am; SiMSCI 8.30am to 5.20pm / 5.50pm to 5.15am; Taiwan 8.45am to 1.45pm / 2.15pm to 5.15am; every NTR (USD/JPY) row 7.25am to 6.30pm / 7.00pm to 5.15am. Included only to anchor the far end of the window; it matches what the repo already holds.

Deltas from GRID A to GRID B for the five families, stated as observations and NOT dated: Nikkei T unchanged, T+1 close 4.45am -> 5.15am. A50 T unchanged, T+1 close 4.45am -> 5.15am, and the contract name gains its "SGX" prefix. SiMSCI Futures T close 5.10 pm -> 5.20pm and T+1 open 5.40 pm -> 5.50pm (Options 5.15 pm -> 5.25pm, T+1 open likewise 5.40 -> 5.50pm). Taiwan T and T+1 open unchanged, T+1 close 4.45am -> 5.15am. NTR suite goes from absent to present at 7.25am to 6.30pm / 7.00pm to 5.15am. The Nikkei Dividend Point contract moves out of its own section into the Nikkei block and is re-timed from 7.30 am to 5.55 pm / 6.25 pm to 4.45 am to 7.30am to 2.25pm / 2.55pm to 5.15am. I did not find any artifact fixing the day any of these took effect and have inferred none.
dead_ends:
EVERY pre-2020 Derivatives Trading Calendar PDF and every pre-2020 DTAM circular linked from the SGX portal is UNRECOVERABLE. All of them live under the retired WebSphere WCM content store at .../wps/wcm/connect/<uuid>/<filename>?MOD=AJPERES, and that store is in neither the Wayback Machine nor the live site.

Link targets I did extract (filenames verbatim as linked, with their WCM UUIDs) — worth recording so a future attempt does not have to re-derive them:
From capture 20170927124017: "SGX_Derivatives Trading Calendar Update (Sep 2017).PDF" 298856d8-0671-438e-8e73-c0d7a2a50d4c; "DTAM 80 of 2016 Year End Trading Schedule_v06.pdf" 9e0bc7d0-1c90-4a39-a5db-c2e2c08ca7f0; "DTAM 80 of 2016 Trading Calendar_Appendix 1_v07_AK (1).pdf" 620b6dca-1cb5-4102-92b3-2b1bfcd97f16; "DTAM 80 of 2016 Trading Calendar_Appendix 2_v07_AK.pdf" 71c3c9b6-5b50-48b7-8a6b-fb690486e743; "DTAM 85 of 2016 Full Year Calendar_2017_v05.pdf" 1b90517a-09f3-4af2-a1cc-1501d6725a8c; "DTAM 85 of 2016 Full year calendar_Appendix 1_v05.pdf" 05a51d36-0cc1-4eaa-aba4-bfddd7a14866.
From capture 20170705000242 (three editions not previously known to exist): "SGX Derivatives Trading Calendar 2016_Oct end Update_FA.PDF" bce57650-845d-4680-b286-691d46e4efa1; "SGX Derivatives Trading Calendar 2015_Aug Update_FA.PDF" 5da48629-63a4-41ee-8fa9-b208bfdfe961; "SGX Derivatives Trading Calendar 2014 - Oct 2014 update_D1.pdf" e036cd33-309f-4dec-b753-3a18ac6aeaf9.
From capture 20181020041054: "SGX Derivatives Trading Calendar 2018  (Apr Update).pdf" (note the DOUBLE space before "(Apr") 52f39ede-508b-47dc-9a43-19b8f2748fc4; "DTAM 84 Year End Trading Schedule.pdf" ff6ee815-3526-4d1d-9a34-50bf35905c69; "DTAM 84 2017 Trading Calendar - Appendix 1 .pdf" 0e34f180-31c0-4064-b1c5-cc559d14effa.
From capture 20181223111840: "DTAM 84 of 2018 - Trading Schedules for Year End 2018_New Year Day 2019.pdf" 2edf7596-b337-4d2d-ab19-eabf72240661; "DTAM 84 of 2018 Trading Calendar Appendix 1.pdf" 5422f1b5-328a-4549-a6d7-62085e40435c.

Proof they are gone, not just hard to find: (1) CDX prefix query on each of the 13 UUIDs under sgx.com/wps/wcm/connect/ returned [] for every one; (2) CDX prefix on sgx.com/wps/wcm/connect/ from 2014 to 2022 filtered to .*pdf.* returns 373 archived WCM PDFs and NONE of them matches calendar|dtam|circular|trading.?hour|schedule|holiday; (3) CDX domain query on sgx.com 2016-2020 filtered to .*calendar.* returns 16 rows, none a PDF; (4) live GET of the WCM URLs returns HTTP 200 text/html at exactly 11792 bytes — the modern SPA 404 shell — not a PDF; (5) sgx.com/wps/wcm/myconnect/ prefix returns 5 rows, all images. No 2016, 2017, 2018 or 2019 calendar edition exists on any SGX host I can reach.

No 2019 calendar edition anywhere. api2.sgx.com CDX 2016-2025 filtered to .*calendar.* returns 7 rows, the earliest under folder 2020-01. I also live-probed 32 plausible api2 paths (folders 2018-12, 2019-01 through 2019-04, 2019-07, 2019-12, 2020-01 crossed with "SGX Derivatives Trading Calendar 2019.pdf", "SGX_Derivatives Trading Calendar 2019.pdf", "DT Trading Calendar 2019.pdf", "SGX Derivatives Trading Calendar 2019 (Final).pdf") — all 404.

No pre-2020 DTAM circular survives anywhere. The only DTAM circulars on api2 are DTAM 67 of 2022, DTAM 64 of 2023, DTAM 93 of 2023, DTAM 6 of 2024 Appendix1, DTAM 87 of 2024, DTAM 24 of 2025 (+Appendix A), DTAM 25 of 2024 Appendix A, DTAM 36 of 2024 Appendix A — every one post-window. infopub.sgx.com filtered for dtam|calendar|trading.?hour yields only listed-company financial calendars. So I have NO "with effect from" line from any SGX circular of this era.

FOUR Titan DTDC newsletters found and downloaded but NOT READABLE — password-protected, and I stopped at the empty-password check as instructed. These are exactly the documents that would date the changes, so this is the most painful dead end:
- api2.sgx.com/sites/default/files/2018-12/Titan DTDC Newsletter - Change of Trading Hours.pdf (archived 20211216195137, 263334 bytes)
- api2.sgx.com/sites/default/files/2018-12/Titan DTDC Newsletter - Extended Trading Hours, Price Limits and Trade at Settlement.pdf (archived 20211128115601, 111272 bytes)
- api2.sgx.com/sites/default/files/2019-07/Titan DTDC Newsletter - Extension of T+1 Trading Hours_0.pdf (archived 20211125035043, 221883 bytes)
- api2.sgx.com/sites/default/files/2019-10/Titan DTDC Newsletter - Ext of T+1 Trading Hours Go Live Schedule.pdf (archived 20211216195121, 488352 bytes)
Encryption is identical across all four: /Filter /Standard, /V 4, /R 4, /Length 128, /CF /StdCF {/CFM /V2} (RC4-128), /P -1028. pypdf decrypt("") returns 0 (NOT_DECRYPTED); pikepdf raises PasswordError: invalid password; pdftotext -opw "" -upw "" reports "Incorrect password". I re-downloaded all four LIVE from api2 today and the byte counts are identical to the archived copies, so the archive replay is not at fault — the documents themselves are member-gated. I also found and tried a live-only variant without the _0 suffix (2019-07/Titan DTDC Newsletter - Extension of T+1 Trading Hours.pdf, 221792 bytes): also encrypted. Their filenames alone are suggestive — an "Extension of T+1 Trading Hours" newsletter uploaded 2019-07 and a "Go Live Schedule" uploaded 2019-10, bracketing the 4.45am -> 5.15am move — but I am reporting the filenames and upload folders only, and asserting nothing about their contents.

Other things checked and found empty: the new-site page sgx.com/derivatives/trading-hours-calendar (and the www2.sgx.com and /securities/ variants) has NO Wayback capture at all, so there is no 2019-era artifact from the rebuilt site. The 2022 capture of the WCM "Trading and Clearing Calendar" fragment (20220811234402) replays only the modern SPA shell. The commodities page (20170606094346) and the top-level trading_hours_calender page (20181231112828) carry neither a grid nor calendar links. The 2018-07-11 WCM "Trading Hours" fragment I fetched only to extract link targets — it has exactly three hrefs (a stylesheet, its own printer-friendly variant, and cmegroup.com) and NO calendar or DTAM links; its grid is the portal-hours-page channel's artifact and I have deliberately not restated it here.

Operational note: the Wayback Machine served "Internet Archive: Temporarily Offline" HTML intermittently throughout this session; my CDX helper treats that page as a retryable failure rather than an empty result, which matters because it otherwise parses as a non-answer. One query (the CDX probe for UUID 620b6dca) exhausted five retries and returned UNAVAILABLE rather than [] — but that same UUID also fails the live probe and is covered by the domain-wide .*pdf.* sweep, so the conclusion holds.
